name: design-map
description: A live design map: Claude keeps a Mermaid class or sequence diagram of the design (elements or messages, decisions, implementation progress); the browser draws it, the pane shows status and text

mapsDir.title: Maps folder
mapsDir.description: Where map files are kept. Empty: ~/.claude/design-maps

nodePath.title: Node for rendering
nodePath.description: A node that has @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli installed globally (its Mermaid bundle feeds the browser page). Empty: node on PATH

port.title: Browser view port
port.description: Port of the local page server (127.0.0.1)

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Opens a box's file from the browser. custom runs editorCommand

editorCommand.title: Custom editor command
editorCommand.description: For editor = custom: run by /bin/sh with {file} and {line} quoted, e.g. nvim --server /tmp/nvim.sock --remote {file}
